name: Check Every Substring
summary: Enumerate every substring, compare its characters inward from both ends, and retain the longest substring whose mirrored characters all match.
visualizationIntent: init: show the string with an empty candidate window. loop: expand the candidate end for every start. check: left and right pointers move inward and flash each mirrored pair. update: a mismatch rejects the candidate; a longer palindrome becomes the highlighted best range. return: the best highlighted substring.

lineExplanations.4: Start the best palindrome at index zero.
lineExplanations.5: A single character is always a palindrome.
lineExplanations.8: Start the right boundary at the left.
lineExplanations.9: Try every substring ending at or after i.
lineExplanations.12: Assume the candidate is a palindrome.
lineExplanations.14: Check whether the mirrored characters differ.
lineExplanations.15: Reject the candidate on a mismatch.
lineExplanations.20: Check whether it is a longer palindrome.
lineExplanations.23: Extend to the next candidate end.
lineExplanations.24: Advance to the next candidate start.

syntaxExplanations.2: def longestPalindrome(self, s): receives the input string.
syntaxExplanations.3: n = len(s) stores the string length.
syntaxExplanations.4: best_lo = 0 stores the best start index.
syntaxExplanations.7: while i < n: visits every left boundary.
syntaxExplanations.8: j = i starts the right boundary.
syntaxExplanations.9: while j < n: visits every candidate end.
syntaxExplanations.10: lo = i places the left comparison pointer.
syntaxExplanations.11: hi = j places the right comparison pointer.
syntaxExplanations.12: is_pal = True initializes the candidate verdict.
syntaxExplanations.13: while lo < hi: compares mirrored characters.
syntaxExplanations.14: if s[lo] != s[hi]: detects a mismatch.
syntaxExplanations.17: lo = lo + 1 moves inward from the left.
syntaxExplanations.18: hi = hi - 1 moves inward from the right.
syntaxExplanations.19: span = j - i + 1 computes substring length.
syntaxExplanations.20: if is_pal and span > best_len: tests for a new best.
syntaxExplanations.21: best_lo = i stores the new start.
syntaxExplanations.22: best_len = span stores the new length.
syntaxExplanations.23: j = j + 1 extends the candidate end.
syntaxExplanations.24: i = i + 1 advances the candidate start.
syntaxExplanations.25: result = s[...] slices the best substring.
